rights: Pokémon designs and Pokémon HOME imagery belong to their respective rights holders. References are used for colour comparison in this noncommercial fan project. Source imagery is not shipped.

references.collection: Pokémon HOME normal and shiny renders preserved by PokéAPI/sprites
references.sourceNotes: Existing multiview and portrait provenance uses the PokéAPI mirror. HOME supplies paired game renders for colour. The mirror documents that its official-artwork/shiny directory contains custom recolours.

inputs.modelBuild: assets/game-models.build.json (match output path, including player-prefixed build keys)

methods.shared: Use the species entry in src/run/view/shiny.ts#shinyPalettes for both outputs.
methods.palette: Use palettes.json under the form ID. Swaps are [from°, to°, width°, saturationScale], at most three. Grey is {hue,amount,value?}. Evaluate the current shinyLook transfer in sRGB on unpremultiplied RGB. Preserve alpha.
methods.texture: Bake the partner GLB on its original UVs using texture-recipes.json and the ordinary illustrated portrait in its own coordinates. The bakedPortrait flag selects spatial_bake.py for both images. Shared hue swaps are exported from src/run/view/shiny.ts#shinyPalettes.
methods.portraitKeep: Apply the shared model parameters followed by the form's portraitOnly mask in texture-recipes.json.

colourCorrections.ivysaur: 花苞在原头像中偏洋红，模型中偏红。分别匹配两段源色相，花苞转桃橙，头像虹膜转琥珀。叶片沿用源图绿色。
colourCorrections.venusaur: 分别匹配原头像的洋红花瓣与模型的红色花瓣，调成高饱和明黄。叶片沿用源图绿色。
colourCorrections.wartortle: 身体调成低饱和淡紫，腹甲偏暖橙。模型背甲与耳尾沿用原分区配色。
colourCorrections.charmeleon: 适度提高金色皮肤的饱和度，沿用同 UV 与头像遮罩保护尾焰。

megaCharizardBake.command: python3 assets/shiny-forms/bake-base-color.py <output-root>; copy candidates/charizard-{x,y}-baseColor.png to public/textures/shiny/charizard-{x,y}.png (scripts/shiny-portraits.mjs skips forms the sim has not registered yet)
megaCharizardBake.verification: bake reproduces public/textures/shiny/charizard.png byte-identically; Blender workbench side/front renders inspected
